body:
Core work is done and merged: OAuth 2.1 (#2709) + default-on MCP surface (#2712), both live-verified end-to-end (discovery → DCR → PKCE → scoped tools under RLS; API-key track regression-tested).

Distribution follow-ups now tracked separately:
- #2713 — official Claude Code plugin (one plugin for every deployment)
- objectstack-ai/objectui#2363 — Setup "Connect an agent" page (incl. the `GET /api/v1/mcp/skill` framework endpoint)
- objectstack-ai/cloud#786 — Anthropic connector directory listing (multi-tenant entry decision + submission)

All remaining distribution work is now consolidated under one tracker: #2714 (phases, repo topology, and the newly-found skill.ts gap — `list_actions`/`run_action` missing from the generated SKILL.md). Closing the loop here; #2713 / objectui#2363 / cloud#786 hang off the tracker.
